item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00134","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C13","C19","C18"],"selected_candidate_label":"C13","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C13 plausibly supplied a material subject-specific template: both orders establish a presidential commission to study land-and-water resource development, utilization, conservation/protection, evaluate programs and project feasibility, recommend legislation, receive interagency cooperation, draw expenses from the President's emergency fund subject to the same statutory exceptions, and report by a fixed deadline. C19 and C18 also closely parallel the later order's generic commission machinery, especially hearings, written reports, cooperation, and financing, but C13 uniquely combines that machinery with the same water-resources policy mission.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Commission shall study the land and water resources of the Missouri River Basin ... and shall prepare recommendations with respect to an integrated and comprehensive program of development, use, and protection of the said resources.","parent_excerpt":"The President's Water Resources Policy Commission shall study, and make recommendations to the President with respect to, Federal responsibility for and participation in the development, utilization, and conservation of water resources, including related land uses","explanation":"The later order adapts the earlier commission's specific water-and-related-land-resources study and recommendation mandate to the Missouri Basin."},{"child_excerpt":"Consider and evaluate existing and proposed plans and programs for the development, protection, and use of land and water resources ... ascertain estimated costs and benefits of projects and programs.","parent_excerpt":"The Commission shall give consideration in particular to ... an appraisal of the priority of water-resources programs from the standpoint of economic and social need, [and] criteria and standards for evaluating the feasibility of water-resources projects","explanation":"Both prescribe evaluation of water-resource programs and the economic feasibility or costs and benefits of projects."},{"child_excerpt":"All departments and other agencies of the Executive branch ... are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission ... and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance ... as it may require","parent_excerpt":"All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance as it may require","explanation":"The cooperation clause is nearly verbatim and occupies the same supporting role."},{"child_excerpt":"The expenditures of the Commission shall be paid out of an allotment made by the President from the appropriation entitled \"Emergency Fund for the President-National Defense\" ... Such payments shall be made without regard to ... section 3681 ... section 9 of the act of March 4, 1909 ... and such other laws as the President may hereafter specify.","parent_excerpt":"the expenditures of the Commission shall be paid out of an allotment made by the President from the appropriation appearing under the heading \"Emergency Fund for the President\" ... Such payments shall be made without regard to ... section 3681 ... section 9 of the act of March 4, 1909 ... and ... such other provisions of law as the President may hereafter specify.","explanation":"The financing mechanism and cited legal exceptions are substantially the same, updated to the current appropriation."},{"child_excerpt":"The Commission shall report to the President, in writing and within one year from the date of this order, the results of its studies and its recommendations ... including any recommendations with respect to necessary legislation.","parent_excerpt":"The Commission shall submit its final report to the President not later than December 1, 1950.","explanation":"Both conclude the commission's work with a deadline-bound presidential report; the later order adds express legislative recommendations and permits earlier reports."}]}
